title: Teacher Lesson Access – Repeated recovery – Existing teacher permissions – No duplicate or cross-teacher change occurs
description: AC-04 — State Transition, Regression — Two activation events remain idempotent.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
Teacher Contact H and Teacher Contact I are assigned to Lesson India.
Teacher H has an inactive Salesforce User and has no teacher permission for Lesson India.
Teacher I has an active Salesforce User and already has one Edit permission for Lesson India.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff changes Teacher H's Salesforce User status from inactive to active."
2. "HQ or CM Staff waits for Teacher H's first recovery request to finish."
3. "HQ or CM Staff changes Teacher H's Salesforce User status from active to inactive."
4. "HQ or CM Staff changes Teacher H's Salesforce User status from inactive to active."
5. "HQ or CM Staff waits for Teacher H's second recovery request to finish."
6. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson permissions for Lesson India."
steps_result:
1. "One recovery request is created for Teacher H."
2. "The first recovery request has status Success."
3. "Teacher H's Salesforce User is inactive."
4. "A new recovery request is created for Teacher H."
5. "The second recovery request has status Success."
6. "Teacher H has exactly one Edit permission and Teacher I still has exactly one Edit permission."
steps_data:
1. "First activation; Previous status = Inactive"
2. "Recovery run = 1"
3. "Intermediate status = Inactive"
4. "Second activation; Previous status = Inactive"
5. "Recovery run = 2"
6. "Expected permissions: Teacher H = 1; Teacher I = 1"
